candidates.title: Will Carlos Alcaraz win at least 4.5 more games than Frances Tiafoe?
candidates.rules_primary: If the game differential in favor of Carlos Alcaraz across the full match is above 4.5 games in the Carlos Alcaraz vs Frances Tiafoe professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP World Tour Finals Men Singles Ivan Lendl Group, then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
The following market refers to the Carlos Alcaraz vs Frances Tiafoe professional tennis match in the 2026 ATP World Tour Finals Men Singles Ivan Lendl Group. If the match does not occur (signaled by a ball being played) due to a player injury, walkover, forfeiture, or any other cancellation (all before the match starts), the market will resolve to a fair price in accordance with the rules. If this match is postponed or delayed, the market will remain open and close after the rescheduled match has finished (within two weeks). If a retirement occurs, all markets that can be unconditionally settled based on play already completed will resolve accordingly. Any markets that cannot be unconditionally settled will resolve to Fair Market Price, as determined at the sole discretion of the Exchange.

candidates.title: Mark Andrews receiving yards ladder
candidates.rules_primary: If Each Yes contract pays $0.0025 per receiving yard recorded by Mark Andrews during the Los Angeles C vs Baltimore Pro Football game originally scheduled for Nov 16, 2026. Each No contract pays $1.00 minus the Yes payout. Yes pays out at most $1.00. Then the market resolves to Yes.
candidates.rules_secondary:
This is a scalar market. The Yes payout per contract is $0.0025 per receiving yard constrained between $0.00–$1.00 with a cap at 400 yards. The No payout is $1.00 minus the Yes payout.
